Types

Context = ref object
  mat*: Mat4                 ## Current matrix
  entries*: Table[Hash, Rect] ## Mapping of image name to atlas UV position
  proj*: Mat4
  pixelate*: bool            ## Makes texture look pixelated, like a pixel game.
  pixelScale*: float32       ## Multiple scaling factor.
